title: How Do Doctors Know When You Need a Hip Replacement?

image.alt: How Do Doctors Know When You Need a Hip Replacement?

html:
Hip pain does not automatically mean you need surgery. In fact, when we assess a patient for hip replacement in Ahmedabad, we look at much more than an X-ray. We consider your pain, mobility, daily activities, overall health, and how well other treatments have worked.

So, how do we decide whether hip replacement is actually the right option?

Is Your Hip Pain Affecting Your Daily Life?

One of the biggest things we consider is how much the pain is interfering with your routine.

If you find it difficult to walk, climb stairs, get up from a chair, put on your shoes, or sleep comfortably because of hip pain, it may be time for a detailed orthopaedic evaluation.

The pain may be felt in the groin, thigh, or buttock and can sometimes become worse with movement. However, symptoms can vary from one person to another.

Have Other Treatments Stopped Helping?

Hip replacement is generally considered when non-surgical treatments are no longer providing enough relief.

Depending on your condition, your doctor may first recommend:

  • Physiotherapy and exercises
  • Weight management, where appropriate
  • Medicines to manage pain and inflammation
  • Activity modification
  • Walking aids when needed

If these measures no longer allow you to carry out everyday activities comfortably, surgery may be discussed.

What Does the X-Ray Show?

We also need to understand what is happening inside the joint. An X-ray can show changes such as narrowing of the joint space, bone spurs, and other signs of arthritis.

But an X-ray alone does not decide whether you need a hip replacement.

This is important because two people can have similar-looking X-rays but very different levels of pain and difficulty with daily activities.

Does Your Overall Health Matter?

Yes. Before recommending surgery, we assess your general health and any conditions that could affect the procedure or recovery. Your age is considered, but there is no single age at which everyone needs a hip replacement.

The decision is ultimately based on whether the condition is significantly affecting your quality of life and whether the expected benefits of surgery outweigh the risks.

At Silver Touch Hospitals, we assess each patient individually before recommending joint replacement. If persistent hip pain is stopping you from doing the things you enjoy, our orthopaedic team can help you understand whether hip replacement in Ahmedabad could be appropriate for you.
